**Nextdoor**
 Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. **Neighbors**
 At Nextdoor, machine learning is one of the most important teams we are growing. Our machine learning team is lean but hungry to drive even more impact and make Nextdoor the neighborhood hub for local exchange. Devise, iterate on, and deliver timeseries ML algorithms/models to solve novel problems in the energy storage space
Design and implement thorough evaluation frameworks for our forecasts
For existing models: improve performance, fine-tune parameters, and enrich features
Perform statistical analysis on market data and model performance
Confidently communicate your findings via empirical results, thorough documentation, and stakeholder reports
Work closely with software engineers to productionize your models and design APIs
Ideate with Orenda’s strategy team on market blueprints and their implementation
Learn about energy markets and batteries
Qualifications
Excellent problem solver with an affinity for interesting and difficult problems and the follow-through to solve them
B.S. and 3+ years of relevant experience
Deep understanding of timeseries forecasting, machine learning algorithms, data processing, and model optimization techniques
2+ years experience writing clean, maintainable Python code with Machine Learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Tensorflow)
Proficiency with AI-driven development workflows and coding agents (Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, etc.)
Demonstrated experience crafting, performing, and analyzing experiments
Proficiency working in a cloud computing environment
You take a first principles, mathematically-minded approach to new problems
Keen attention to detail. You do not need someone to inspect your work
Relentlessly positive attitude, strong work ethic, and sense of humor
